title: Studio item header: a long api-name chip takes the title's room, so a Data item's title is cut to "Service T…" (about 100 px) against objectui#12611's 200 px floor
body:
Filing gate: ① — a user-visible defect with a named location, measured in a real browser. It is an out-of-scope finding of objectui#12707's dev (`session_01Umh5XoHZFaBP7A8Kc2g2Jc`), filed by the seat that dispatched it, `domain:ui#4` (`session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`).

## What happens

Studio, a writable package, Data pillar, a new draft object labelled "Service Territory Assignment 105" (api name `probe_service_territory_assignment_105`), against HotCRM under `objectstack dev`:
- At a 560 px header row, the title reads "Service T…" at about 100 px. The api-name chip and the Unpublished draft chip stay whole.
- At 1024 px (a 736 px row) the title is already truncated.

Evidence (an evidence branch, never merged): [data-draft-object-row560-light.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/6012be82d1f938b683d7f7faaff15990f77d5baa/docs/design/findings/12707/data-draft-object-row560-light.png?raw=true). It was taken on objectui#12707's branch at `14ce373`, whose item-header title row is the same as `main`'s.

## Why (read on `main` `4857cd2`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioItemHeader.tsx` (about :187–193) draws the title, then the api-name chip, in one flex row:
- the title is `STUDIO_ITEM_TITLE` (`studio-tokens.ts:75`): `min-w-0 truncate`, with no floor;
- the api-name chip is `STUDIO_API_CHIP` (`studio-tokens.ts:77`): `shrink-0`.

So a long api name keeps its full width, and the title gives way to almost nothing.

objectui#12611's target 2 reads: "the item header hides the meta slot first (below 1100 px content width), then the status chip's text (icon stays, text in tooltip), and truncates the title last; the title keeps at least 200 px." Its fix (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12631) covered the meta slot and the status chip. The api-name chip was not in its measurements, and nothing gives way before the title when the api name is long.

## Target

The title keeps at least 200 px. Where the row cannot hold the title, the api-name chip and the chips after it, the api-name chip truncates first, keeping its full name in its tooltip. The title truncates last. objectui#11665 and objectui#7254 pin the api name's place, so the chip is not moved, only made to give way.

## Acceptance

1. A test at a 560 px header row with a 30-character api name: the title's width is at least 200 px, and the api chip is truncated with its full name in its tooltip.
2. CONTROL: with a short api name at 560 px, the chip is whole.
3. A screenshot of the same draft object at 560 px and at 1024 px, light.

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The reader is a `domain:ui` objectui developer: `StudioItemHeader.tsx` and `studio-tokens.ts`, with tests beside them.

## Dedupe (2026-10-16, MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed)

"Studio item header title truncates when the api name chip is long, title keeps at least 200 px": 8 hits. The nearest are objectui#12611 (closed; its target 2 is the rule this card says is unmet), objectui#12707 (open; the read-only link in the tab row, not the title row), and objectui#7244 (closed; the record page's title chip, a different header). None is this card.
